false;\n        }\n\n        // Compare labels (order independent)\n        let mut self_labels = self.labels.clone();\n        self_labels.sort_unstable();\n        self_labels.dedup();\n        let mut other_labels = other.labels.clone();\n        other_labels.sort_unstable();\n        other_labels.dedup();\n        if self_labels != other_labels {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.depends_on_id.cmp(&right.depends_on_id))\n                .then_with(|| left.dep_type.as_str().cmp(right.dep_type.as_str()))\n            .then_with(|| left.metadata.cmp(&right.metadata))\n                .then_with(|| left.thread_id.cmp(&right.thread_id))\n        });\n        if self_deps != other_deps {\n            return .then_with(|| left.body.cmp(&right.body))\n                .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))\n        });\n        let mut other_comments = other.comments.clone();\n        other_comments.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.author.cmp(&right.author))\n                .then_with(|| left.body.cmp(&right.body))\n                .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))\n        });\n        if self_comments != other_comments {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        true\n    }\n\n    /// Check if this issue is a tombstone that has exceeded its TTL.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn {\n            return false;\n        };\n\n        if days == 0 {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        let Some(deleted_at) = self.deleted_at else {\n            return false;\n highest priority\n        // Note: With numerical ordering where 0 < 1 < 2, CRITICAL has the lowest value\n        // but represents the highest priority in human terms\n        assert!(Priority::CRITICAL < Priority::HIGH);\n        assert!(Priority::CRITICAL < Priority::MEDIUM);\n        assert!(Priority::CRITICAL < Priority::LOW);\n        assert!(Priority::CRITICAL < Priority::BACKLOG);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_p0_priority_total_ordering() {\n        // Test that Priority enum has correct total ordering\n        let priorities = vec![\n            Priority::CRITICAL, // P0\n            Priority::HIGH,     // P1\n            Priority::MEDIUM,   // P2\n            Priority::LOW,      // P3\n            Priority::BACKLOG,  // P4\n        ];\n\n        // Verify each priority is less than the next one\n        for i in 1..priorities.len() {\n            assert!(\n                priorities[i - 1] < priorities[i],\n                \"Priority
